text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: [P1] Canary failures detected for service=redwood-serving in us-west-2 (canary-id=canary-3). Error rate 28% over 2 minutes. Auto-escalation in 5m unless acked. Logs: `http 502 /predict`

sara: acked from mobile, taking initial triage. I'm on-call.

pagerduty-bot: pagerduty:incident/INC-4821 assigned to sara (oncall). Escalation to mike if not acknowledged in 5 minutes.

mike: on my way, jumping in. can someone paste the failing log snippet?

alex: pasting small sample from canary-3: ```
2026-03-14T04:12:09Z redwood-serving canary-3 ERROR handler: upstream connection reset by peer
2026-03-14T04:12:10Z redwood-serving canary-3 ERROR model-runtime: kv-cache miss; fallback serialization error
```

jordan: looks like 502 + kv-cache hits dropping. I'm seeing a surge of long-tail latencies in the metric group `serve.latency.p90`. chart: https://metrics.internal/redwood/serve.latency?env=prod&region=us-west-2

liz: customer-impact check: a handful of premium customers report timeouts in product metrics; support ticket count up 3 in last 10m. No broad outage yet.

sara: plan: 1) pause rollout for this release id=rel-2026-03-14-7 2) roll canary back to previous image on the affected node pool 3) gather core logs for further RCA. Anyone available to perform rollback?

mike: will run the rollback, handing PD to julian for alert follow-ups. julian can you ack PD?

julian: acked PD and taking follow-up comms. I'll post updates to #incidents-status and notify CS.

ops-bot: deploy-halt: rollout rel-2026-03-14-7 paused by sara. autoscale-disabled for nodepool=canary-pool-usw2.

alex: rollback command (k8s): ```bash
kubectl -n serving set image deployment/redwood-serving redwood-serving=registry.redwood.ai/redwood-serving:20260210-rc3
kubectl -n serving rollout status deployment/redwood-serving --timeout=5m
```

mike: running now — tailing pods.

mike: quick health-check curl to canary endpoint before/after: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://canary-usw2.redwood.ai/predict -d '{"prompt":"healthcheck"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CANARY_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' | jq .
```

mike: rollback started. seeing pods restart. initial probes failing then stabilizing. p95 latency dropping from 1.8s -> 220ms.

alex: note: we observed increased connection resets from the kv-cache hostgroup `kv-3a`. I'm creating a ticket to repro locally.

pagerduty-bot: pagerduty:incident/INC-4821 acknowledged by julian. Escalation paused.

julian: contacting support ops to flag affected customers, will send short message: "We're investigating elevated errors in canary deployments impacting some requests in us-west-2. Rolling back the release now; we expect restored service within 10-15 minutes."

liz: :thumbsup: heads-up to CS: I've created a private notes doc and posted to the support queue. linking ticket IDs: SUP-8721, SUP-8722.

mike: rollback finished. verification: all readiness probes green. health-check curl returns 200 and payload ok.

ops-bot: rollout-relay: rel-2026-03-14-7 marked ROLLED_BACK by mike. Canary pool returned to previous image.

sara: great. I'm going to keep the incident open for postmortem and RCA. Please collect traces for the 04:10-04:20 window and add any interesting logs to the incident doc. Assigning follow-ups: alex (kv-cache analysis), jordan (latency regression triage), mike (rollback playbook updates), liz (customer comms follow-up).

alex: grabbing logs now, saving to /incidents/INC-4821/artifacts/kvcache-logs.tar.gz

mike: suggest we add a temporary monitor on kv-cache hostgroup for connection resets > 5/min to catch recurrence.

julian: leaving PD to sara in 10m. Sara, if you want to handback earlier say so.

sara: will take PD back after I validate customer tickets. thanks everyone.

mike: small note for the postmortem: consider adding a canary-only toggle to disable kv-cache usage during rollout to reduce blast radius.

sara: recorded action items in the incident doc. closing slack thread for live coord, will reopen on RCA draft. :white_check_mark:
